name: effects_particle_self_stop
description: Test 16: a particle component started with Start(0) goes inactive on its own. The loop-budget emitter (flag bit 1) emits its one loop, calls Stop(0) (the delayed stop) on itself, and CheckForStop clears started when the last particle dies: life 3 s at 0.5 s per update ends on update 7 (6 ageing updates after the burst). The duration emitter (no bits) ends after its budget and the last particle. The plain emitter (bit 2) never self-stops; a delayed Stop(0) lets its particles play out, a hard Stop(1) ends it at once.
